# The Bojin Method

> At-home facial self-care education from Taiwan-based Bojin instructor Yu-Ting Lan, founder of Héhé Studio (和合雅築).

This file is a selected navigation summary. Use the linked pages for their full context, sources, limitations, and current details. The journal directory lists the articles; this file is not a complete article archive or a clinical reference.

## Scope
- The Bojin Method teaches optional facial self-care. It is not medical diagnosis, treatment, or rehabilitation.
- Bojin and gua sha are distinct practices. Evidence or instructions about gua sha do not automatically establish Bojin benefits or suitable technique.
- A subjective feeling of comfort or relaxation does not establish deeper tissue release, structural lifting, improved skincare absorption, or a lasting cosmetic result.
- Do not treat pain, bruising, redness, or stronger sensation as a goal. A comfortable sensation alone does not establish that a practice is appropriate for a person's health, skin, medication, or recovery after a procedure.
- Eye Reset is the free 3-minute Inner Brow Release demonstration, not a complete face routine. The 1-minute Face Tension Profile quiz and the 5-Zone Face Tension Self-Check guide are separate resources, not diagnostic tools.

## Guides by concern
- [Browse all 99 guides](https://bojinfacetension.com/blog.html): the complete, searchable journal organized by concern, 3-phase modular guides, and 5-minute home routines.
- [Tired, puffy eyes](https://bojinfacetension.com/blog-tired-puffy-eyes.html): why eyes look puffy after 40, and a gentle 5-minute morning eye reset.
- [Softer jawline and double chin](https://bojinfacetension.com/blog-jawline-double-chin.html): the role of tension, sluggish drainage and tech-neck posture, plus a 5-minute jaw and neck release.
- [Smile lines and cheeks](https://bojinfacetension.com/blog-smile-lines-cheeks.html): why smile lines deepen and a gentle cheek-lifting ritual.
- [Frown lines and forehead](https://bojinfacetension.com/blog-forehead-frown-lines.html): releasing a heavy, tense brow.
- [Dull, puffy skin and glow](https://bojinfacetension.com/blog-dull-puffy-glow.html): a full-face bojin sweep for circulation and glow.
- [Jowls along the jawline](https://bojinfacetension.com/blog-jowls-sagging-along-jawline.html): why jowls aren't a double chin or just weight, and what a gentle release can honestly reach.
- ["Necklace" lines on the neck](https://bojinfacetension.com/blog-necklace-lines-horizontal-neck.html): horizontal neck folds from years of looking down, and what eases them.
- [Hollow, sunken under-eyes (tear troughs)](https://bojinfacetension.com/blog-tear-trough-hollow-under-eyes.html): the shadow is three layers — a hollow, thin skin, and pooled fluid — and only two respond to a gentle release.
- [Crepey skin on the neck and under the eyes](https://bojinfacetension.com/blog-crepey-skin-neck-under-eyes.html): a texture problem, not a line problem, and what hydration and circulation can honestly soften.
- [Sallow, dull, grey complexion](https://bojinfacetension.com/blog-sallow-dull-grey-complexion.html): often about circulation, not products, and a gentle way to turn it back up.

## About the instructor
Yu-Ting Lan (藍玉婷) is the founder of Héhé Studio (和合雅築) and a Taiwan-based Bojin instructor. See the About page for her teaching background and the credentials presented on this site.
